text:
Maya Singh: noticed sudden spike in fncall schema rejects for invoices service, majority routed to degen. console sampling shows 0 examples which is awkward for customer support.
Tom Brewer: which validator flagged it? logs?
Maya Singh: validator=strict-schema-v2, error: missing 'payment.method' inside action.payload. sample log below.
Ivy Chen: did we change handshake or shape for payments? I didn't push anything.
Rajat Kapoor: related to the rolloutI flipped strict-schema-v2 to partial canary at 10:05 UTC. saw a small uptick but not this magnitude.
deploy-bot: deployment started: strict-schema-v2 canary -> 4 hosts (hosts: s-2091). ETA 2m
Maya Singh: sample log: `2026-02-03T10:08:17Z invoke=inv-77 route=degen model=gpt-open-quant error=validate_fncall missing payment.method quota_tag=reserved-eu`
Tom Brewer: console sampling job has known issue where it filters on route_type='tool' instead of route_id values; it misses degen. I'll open PR.
Ivy Chen: billing question: does degen traffic count toward committed reserved throughput? customers will be upset if noise inflates usage.
Rajat Kapoor: metering drops route_id for validation rejects currently (we strip the metadata when response is a rejection). That explains billing ambiguity. filing tracker now.
Maya Singh: short-term: we should return a structured rejection payload so SDKs + console can surface "why". propose adding header `x-rw-fn-reject: schema:payment.method` and a JSON body with `reason` and `how_to_fix` fields.
Tom Brewer: agree. will also make sampling fix priority so samples appear in console. PRs: sampling fix #8321, preserve-route-in-metering #8322.
Ivy Chen: product wants a tiny UX: in route timeline show "schema reject (field missing)" with link to sample. filed CON-2110
Rajat Kapoor: can we mitigate by adding a permissive fallback for one hour to reduce customer impact? we could let calls through to a safe degen handler that returns best-effort.
Maya Singh: okay for 1h. i'll add a temp feature flag to relax validator for payments namespace.
deploy-bot: rollback scheduled if reject_rate > 0.5% for 10m
Tom Brewer: ping me when sampling PR merges; i'll verify console shows examples.
Maya Singh: posting updates here after fixes land. thanks all.
